title: Health Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Its Complications: A Machine Learning Algorithm-Based Retrospective Study in Chinese Communities.
summary: A retrospective cohort of 4,916 Shanghai community patients used LASSO/SVM/tree screening and logistic/Bayesian-network models to predict T2DM complications and associations among indicators. This is local retrospective risk analysis, not an intervention result.
